metadata.description: Local-only SEC batch job manifest for reviewed repeatable candidate ingestion runs. This file is not loaded by the app and must not promote or write production graph data.
job_scope_notes: Job limit means filings reviewed per ticker after form filtering.
Job limit is not a cap on relationships found or candidate records surfaced.
Higher filing limits may take longer and may require more SEC network/cache work when network access is enabled.
Production promotion remains separate from local job runs and must not be triggered by this manifest.
source_policy_notes: Jobs are local terminal orchestration only.
Network calls require explicit --allow-network and --user-agent at run time.
Candidate writes require explicit --write-candidates at run time.
Production promotion remains separate and must not be triggered by this manifest.

jobs.description: Starter approved mega-cap SEC relationship scan for current AAPL/MSFT/NVDA mappings
Standard/default Batch 1 multi-sector SEC relationship scan using approved CIK mappings; limit 10 means filings reviewed per ticker, not relationships found.
Fast Batch 1 multi-sector SEC relationship scan using approved CIK mappings; reviews 10 filings per ticker and does not cap relationships found.
Deep Batch 1 multi-sector SEC relationship scan using approved CIK mappings; reviews 25 filings per ticker and may require more SEC/cache work.
